model.note: Part outlines are traced from Victa's product photo and are approximate. No Victa or Briggs & Stratton operator's manual or parts book was obtained: the manual and parts links open dealer specification pages, intervals are best practice, and there are no part numbers yet. Read the engine model-type-code and check the deck size (42 or 48 in.) on Amstel Zero Turn 1 (serial 1808210691573) before ordering anything.

deck.name: Mower deck (fabricated)
deck.desc: Fabricated deck, 42 in. (ZTX2342F, 2691742) or 48 in. (ZTX2348F, 2691743): check which is fitted. Height of cut 38-114 mm in 7 to 13 positions depending on model. Daily: deck underside clear of build-up. Yearly: check deck level.

spindles.name: Deck spindles
spindles.desc: Cast-aluminium greasable spindles. Grease every 25 h with general-purpose lithium grease (best practice).

blades.name: Mower blades
blades.desc: Daily: sharp, not bent, bolts tight. Every 25 h: inspect and sharpen (sooner after hitting debris). Sharpen to the original angle and balance after sharpening; replace if bent, cracked or worn into the sail. Blade number depends on the deck: check the deck before ordering. The taskTracker 'Sharpen Blades (200 h)' template is too long for a rotary deck: make it 25 h.

belt.name: Deck drive belt
belt.desc: Yearly: check the deck belt, pulleys and idlers. Belt number depends on the deck size.

beltcover.name: Deck belt cover
beltcover.desc: Cover over the deck belt. Yearly: check the deck belt, pulleys and idlers under it.

liftlever.name: Deck lift lever
liftlever.desc: Sets the height of cut: 38-114 mm in 7 to 13 positions depending on model.

engine.name: Engine: Briggs & Stratton 23 hp
engine.desc: Briggs & Stratton Professional Series OHV, 23 hp gross. The exact model-type-code is not published: read the engine label and look up filters and plugs with a Victa or B&S dealer. Daily: oil level and fuel; clean grass off the engine screen and cooling fins. Oil and filter: 100 h or 12 months as a best-practice placeholder (first change early); confirm interval, oil spec and capacity in the B&S manual. The taskTracker 'Service - Minor (250 h)' template is too long: change to 100 h or 12 months.

oil.name: Engine oil and filter
oil.desc: Change oil and filter at 100 h or 12 months (best practice; confirm in the B&S manual). Oil spec, capacity and filter number depend on the engine model-type-code.

airfilter.name: Air cleaner
airfilter.desc: Daily: air cleaner and pre-cleaner condition. Clean the pre-cleaner every 25 h; replace the air filter yearly (best practice). Part number depends on the engine.

plugs.name: Spark plugs
plugs.desc: Replace yearly (best practice). Part number depends on the engine model-type-code.

fuel.name: Fuel tank and filter
fuel.desc: 11.4 L unleaded. Replace the fuel filter yearly if one is fitted.

transaxles.name: Hydro-Gear EZT transaxles (x2)
transaxles.desc: Dual Hydro-Gear EZT transaxles, air-cooled and factory-sealed (confirm). Daily: clean grass off the transaxles; build-up on the cooling fins causes overheating and loss of drive. Yearly: check for leaks and the cooling fan and fins.

tyreR.name: Rear drive tyres
tyreR.desc: Daily: pressures even (uneven pressures give an uneven cut and pull to one side). Yearly: tyre condition.

casterL.name: Front caster, left
casterL.desc: Grease the front caster pivots every 25 h with general-purpose lithium grease (best practice).

casterR.name: Front caster, right
casterR.desc: Grease the front caster pivots every 25 h with general-purpose lithium grease (best practice).

fenderR.name: Rear fender, right
fenderR.desc: Fender over the right rear tyre, carrying the ZTX decal.

fenderL.name: Rear fender, left
fenderL.desc: Fender over the left rear tyre.

panel.name: Centre body panel
panel.desc: Panel between the seat and the footrest.

frame.name: Front frame and footrest
frame.desc: Front frame carrying the casters and the operator footrest. This is a domestic-rated machine (3-year domestic warranty) used commercially: expect shorter component life.

seat.name: Seat
seat.desc: Seat with seat switch. Daily: seat switch interlock works. Yearly: check seat and ROPS hardware.

levers.name: Steering levers
levers.desc: Zero-turn steering levers driving the two EZT transaxles. Daily: park brake works.

console.name: Left control console
console.desc: Engine controls beside the seat. Daily: blade engage and park brake interlocks work.

interlocks.name: Safety interlocks
interlocks.desc: Daily: seat switch, park brake and blade engage interlocks work.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Yearly: clean and tighten the battery terminals.
